title: FieldPoly integration docs + bench consolidation
description:
Close-out task for the bdf95060 story: consolidate docs, bench, and add a narrow integration helper.

## Scope

- Module-level docstring in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs` enumerates all operations with complexity, mirroring the table in `batch_ops.rs`.
- Consolidated bench harness `crates/gf2-core/benches/field_poly.rs`: `batch_evaluate` vs Horner (from Task 3), `interpolate_fast` vs `interpolate` (from Task 4), `mul_ntt` vs Karatsuba (from Task 7). Regenerate tables; paste into the module docstring.
- Narrow integration helper `pub(crate) fn gf2m_poly_to_field_poly(&Gf2mPoly) -> FieldPoly<Gf2mElement>` and its inverse, in `crates/gf2-core`. Proptest-level round-trip test. **No bch rewrite** — out of scope.
- Short overview `dev/plans/field_poly_module_overview.md` linking each API to its algorithmic reference.

## Success criteria

- `cargo test --workspace --all-features --release` ≤ 60s (CLAUDE.md rule). If this task pushes budget, move long proptests behind `#[ignore]`.
- All three gates pass: `code-review`, `doc-review`, `cargo-ci`.
- Round-trip proptest passes for `gf2m_poly_to_field_poly`.

## Depends on

Tasks 3, 4, 5, 7.
